features: Ceramic non-stick interior that resists scratching and staining
Exceptionally durable dishwasher safe cookware for easy clean up
Non-stick exterior is a breeze to clean
Even heat base delivers even heat distribution for reliable cooking results
Ceramic cooking surface resists heat up to 570° Fahrenheit; Oven safe up to 350 degrees Fahrenheit
description: T-fal Initiatives Ceramic cookware has a new, beautiful grey cooking surface and still makes it easier than ever to cook healthier, nutritious and delicious meals at home. The cookware’s heavy-gauge aluminum construction and even heat base offer durable strength, efficient cooking and even heat distribution for reliably consistent results. Recyclable and PTFE-, PFOA-, and Cadmium-free, the cookware’s innovative grey ceramic nonstick interior provides easy food release with just a little oil and can handle high cooking-surface temperatures up to 570°F—perfect for searing meat, fish, poultry, and more to delicious perfection. The ultra durable ceramic interior resists scratches and staining, ensuring high quality performance and long lasting good looks. Ergonomically designed heat resistant handles provide a comfortable and secure grip and are oven safe to 350°F (use an oven mitt), while vented, tempered-glass lids offer at-a-glance monitoring. Dishwasher safe, the cookware cleans up in a flash—no messy overnight soaking required. With its high gloss exterior and beautiful grey interior, T-fal Initiatives Ceramic cookware makes a great gift idea for newlyweds, new homeowners, or anyone looking for a durable and stylish collection.
